parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 rows from the metabolism table. Join substrate_record_id to compound_records and then to compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles and substrate_compound_key; this substrate-side join is mandatory so canonical_smiles and substrate_compound_key must not be null. Join metabolite_record_id to compound_records to retrieve metabolite_compound_key; this metabolite-side join may be optional if the metabolite record is absent. Return exactly canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, and pathway_key. Do not add sorting.
